result.summary: Found 1 issue: a restaurant card in the Popular right now section shows a broken image placeholder instead of its photo.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card under Popular right now displays a large gray area with a generic broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo, so the image failed to load or is missing.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source so the restaurant photo loads, and use a designed fallback (such as a branded placeholder with the restaurant name) rather than the default broken-image icon.
